title: Dubai (UAE) Tourist Visa
feeNote: Includes the UAE visa fee for standard applications.
summary: A fast, online e-visa for Dubai and the rest of the UAE. Send your documents on WhatsApp and we do the rest.
overview: The UAE tourist visa is issued electronically, so there is no embassy appointment. You send us your passport data page, photograph and supporting documents on WhatsApp, and we submit your application and send you the visa by email once it is issued.
requirements: Passport data page (valid for at least 6 months)
Passport photograph with a white background

steps.title: Send your documents
steps.description: Share clear copies of your passport and photograph on WhatsApp.

steps.title: Visa issued
steps.description: We send your visa by email and WhatsApp, usually within a working week.

excluded: Flights and hotels (see our Dubai packages)

faqs.q: Do I get the visa with a Dubai package?
faqs.a: Yes. Our Dubai packages already include visa processing, so you only need this service if you are booking flights and hotels yourself.
